operations.name: Saw Cut Tube Blanks
operations.setup_note: Support seamless mechanical tubing in the saw vice and use a length stop to prepare blanks with facing allowance at both ends. Reserve an additional blank for the provisional destructive-test sample.

operations.name: CNC Turn – First End
operations.setup_note: Grip the opposite raw tube end in wraparound soft jaws, picking up the tube axis and establishing the first finished end face as a process reference. Machine the exposed flange and accessible body portion, size the bore from this end with a rigid boring bar, and form the end-face serrations without unclamping.

operations.name: CNC Turn – Second End
operations.setup_note: Reverse into bored soft jaws gripping the finished central OD, locate axially against the first flange's back shoulder, and provide clearance around the completed serrations. Face to the under-knurl overall length, finish the previously held OD region, overlap the first-end bore sizing, and serrate the exposed end in this clamping.

operations.name: Production Deburr and Clean
operations.setup_note: Handle completed turned parts at the production bench and remove loose burrs from both bore mouths, flange edges, and serrations without blunting the specified tooth profile. Break otherwise sharp edges within the drawing's 0.5 mm maximum and remove chips and machining-fluid residue.

operations.name: Batch Phosphate Coating
operations.setup_note: Load fully machined parts into the in-house bulk phosphate barrel; the 100-piece order and reserved test sample are assumed to fit one validated load. Apply PS-119.0 cleaning, oxide removal or activation, rinsing, phosphating, and final rinse/drying requirements, confirming water-break cleanliness before treatment.

operations.name: Final Shop-Floor Quality Gate
operations.setup_note: Present sampled coated parts to dedicated bore and flange gauges and an under-knurl length fixture, using the bore axis and finished shoulders as process references. Check the remaining profile characteristics and phosphate coverage under the approved sampling plan, and hold lot release pending sampled crush-test acceptance.

operations.name: Sampled Crush Test
operations.setup_note: Send a sacrificial finished sample to a qualified vendor for fixturing and crush testing per PS-122.10, including the specified 121 kN, 60.5 kN, and 0.38 mm criteria as defined by that procedure. Provisionally test one sample for the 100-piece lot rather than every delivered component.

clarifications.question: Can you provide the applicable revision of phosphate-coating specification PS-119.0?
clarifications.suggested_default: Quote full-surface in-house batch phosphating without masking or baking; confirm the specification before production and keep finished dimensions within drawing limits after treatment.

clarifications.question: Can you provide the applicable revision of crush-test procedure PS-122.10?
clarifications.suggested_default: Quote qualified outside testing provisionally; do not infer loading direction, fixture, or acceptance sequence from the three listed numerical criteria.

clarifications.question: What crush-test sampling frequency is required for this 100-piece lot?
clarifications.suggested_default: One sacrificial coated sample per lot of 100 deliverable pieces, requiring one additional blank.

clarifications.question: What dimensional tolerance applies to the Ø23 central outer cylinder?
clarifications.suggested_default: Use ±0.10 mm for provisional quotation only; obtain the approved tolerance before machining.

clarifications.question: Which two drawing characteristics carry the mandatory conformance symbols?
clarifications.suggested_default: Include all specified critical characteristics in the provisional shop-floor control plan without adding a 100% CMM inspection.

assumptions.text: Precision seamless mechanical tubing is procurable at nominal Ø28.5 OD × Ø13.25 ID; incoming dimensional variation must leave cleanup stock throughout. The 82 mm cut length includes facing allowance.
The material arrives in an unhardened machinable condition. No heat treatment or subsequent grinding is required because neither is specified.
No drawing datums are invented: the bore axis, first finished face, and flange shoulder are manufacturing references only, so datum_references remains empty.

Each lathe setup executes a consolidated G71/G70 OD profile. Separate flange and body sub-operations represent their different diameters, not separate clampings or repeated full-stock removal; the two setups divide the body length into accessible regions with only a blending overlap.

The existing tube bore needs light single-pass finish sizing from overlapping end accesses. Rough boring, hole-making center/spot drilling, pilot drilling, full drilling, and peck drilling are omitted because no solid core must be removed; reaming and honing are unnecessary for the specified ±0.15 mm bore tolerance.

Each R2 transition receives a dedicated groove_od contouring sub-operation using suitable form/grooving tooling after adjacent surfaces are finished. This produces the specified fillet, not an additional relief groove.
F01 is an end-face serration pattern produced by validated turret-mounted face-knurl/form tooling in each lathe clamping. Provisionally use 30 equally spaced teeth, within the specified 28–32 range.
The two specified bore-mouth chamfers are provisionally interpreted as 45° chamfers because their angle is not supplied.

Turning-template center drilling is omitted because the tubular component is not machined between centers and its overall L/D is below 4. Threading, tapping, and thread-relief operations are omitted because no threads exist; part-off is omitted because individual blanks are already saw cut and both ends are subsequently faced.

The hole-making countersink/counterbore/spotface step is represented only by the specified lathe-cut bore-mouth chamfers; no fastener recesses or spotfaces are added. Hole deburring is consolidated into the production bench gate.
The preloaded milling sequence is inapplicable: there are no flats, cross-holes, pockets, or slots. All serrations remain within the two lathe setups, so no VMC or SPM operation is included.

Phosphate treatment provisionally covers all surfaces. Surface-treatment masking and unmasking are omitted because no coating exclusion, H7-or-tighter bore, or thread is specified; curing and hydrogen-embrittlement baking are omitted for the unhardened low-carbon component unless PS-119.0 requires otherwise.

The order is provisionally 100 deliverable components plus one additional sacrificial crush-test sample. Crush testing is subcontracted because a qualified compression-test capability is not identified among the shop's listed test-bench capabilities.

Blank cutting, cleaning, deburring, coating, inspection, and testing use empty target_feature_ids where they do not create an explicitly modeled geometric feature. Repeated F01, F04, and F05 identifiers in the two lathe setups denote their opposite-end instances.
